{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of March 2013 – January 2014. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 8.3''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[A Wretched Hive (Virtual Block 8)|Virtual Block 8.3: A Wretched Hive]]. The 8.3 PDF has official text as of 28 March 2013.<ref name="pdf83">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: A Wretched Hive''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of March 28, 2013". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174721/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> No release post or tournament-legal date was found: the Players Committee's news list goes from "New Persona Changes" (29 January 2013) to "V-Card Alternate Image Cards Announcement" (16 April 2013) with no 8.3 post between them.<ref name="j353">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=353&catid=1&Itemid=117 V-Card AI Sheet Now Live!], Players Committee (27 April 2013; Latest News list to "V9.1 Preview Set", 9 July 2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130712075217/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=353&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> Decklists of the [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (19–21 April 2013) already use 8.3 cards such as [[Luuke]] and [[Guardian's Lightsaber]].<ref name="ev-2013 Texas Mini Worlds">Decklists of the [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] on this wiki.</ref> The pool lasted until 9 January 2014; Virtual Block 9.1 was legal immediately on its release on 10 January 2014.<ref name="wp91">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/ V-set 9.1 is live!], Players Committee (10 January 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20140114065911/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/ Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's name for its constructed format until 2014 was ''Standard'': the 25 July 2014 announcement that replaced this pool was titled "Reset of Standard Format" and said that "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> "Legacy" was created only then, for the pre-reset cards.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–7 and Virtual Block 8.1–8.3 (and, from mid-2013, the V9.1 Preview Set)
* '''In use:''' March 2013 (official text 28 March; legal date unknown, in use by 19 April) – 9 January 2014
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[A Wretched Hive (Virtual Block 8)|8.3 A Wretched Hive]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. == History ==
A Wretched Hive closed Block 8 with 29 cards (14 Dark Side, 15 Light Side), including the four cards of the December 2012 8.3 Preview Set, which were already in the pool (see [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.2]]).<ref name="w-awh" /><ref name="j348">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=348&catid=1&Itemid=117 Merry Christmas, SWCCG!], Players Committee (20 December 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003503/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=348&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''V9.1 Preview Set.''' The Players Committee's news list has a "V9.1 Preview Set" post dated 9 July 2013; the post itself was not preserved, so its legal date is unknown.<ref name="j353" /> Decklists of the [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (13–14 July 2013) show no 9.1 cards, while decklists of the [[2013 World Championship]] (9–11 August 2013) include preview cards such as [[Much to Learn, You Still Have]], later part of 9.1 Republic At War.<ref name="ev-2013 Alderaan Regionals">Decklists of the [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] on this wiki.</ref><ref name="ev-2013 World Championship">Decklists of the [[2013 World Championship]] on this wiki.</ref><ref name="w-raw">[[Republic At War (Virtual Block 9)]]</ref> This wiki does not treat the preview as a separate pool: from mid-2013 this pool is 8.3 plus the V9.1 preview cards.
